malfunctionassessment.fault-code: ENG 1 BLEED STATUS FAULT;ENG 2 BLEED STATUS FAULT

cond-routing.intro: If this alert is displayed on the EWD before the first engine start, check that no amber cross is displayed on the ENG for OIL TEMP indication of the affected engine. If an amber cross is displayed, the associated EIU may be the cause of the failure (associated engine start not possible).
